_about: The five-day mission plan. Day 1 is the academy. Each outpost day lists its tasks in order; ids are what the stations report to MissionDirector.complete_task().

tasks.title: Check outpost power
tasks.description: Use the console in the west power room.

tasks.title: Check the greenhouse
tasks.description: Use the lamp control under the water tank in the east greenhouse.

tasks.title: Plant the greenhouse
tasks.description: Help Dr. Tanaka seed the plant pillows.

tasks.title: Crew health check
tasks.description: Ride the exercise bike in the power room and log your health check.

tasks.title: Check outpost power
tasks.description: Morning routine: check the battery and the sunlight forecast.

tasks.title: Check the greenhouse
tasks.description: Morning routine: set the grow lights for today.

tasks.title: Light-recipe experiment
tasks.description: Run the LED experiment at the greenhouse lamp control.

tasks.title: Soil or regolith?
tasks.description: Sort the soil samples with Dr. Tanaka.

tasks.title: First harvest
tasks.description: Taste the first leaves with Dr. Tanaka.

tasks.title: Check outpost power
tasks.description: Morning routine: plan power for the coming shadow.

tasks.title: Check the greenhouse
tasks.description: Morning routine: check on the crops.

tasks.title: Storm Spotter
tasks.description: Watch the sun-cam at the comms desk and catch the flares and CMEs.

tasks.title: Message to Earth
tasks.description: Send a radio message from the comms desk and see how long it takes.

tasks.title: Shelter drill
tasks.description: Practice: hold E to crank the shelter hatch open, then step inside.

tasks.title: Check the greenhouse
tasks.description: Morning routine: check the crops before the shift.
